title: Grofers-Rakhi Social Media Campaign
summary:
Grofers Rakhi Social Media Campaign


Rakshabandhan is the festival celebrated to cherish the siblings relationship. We created this campaign to celebrate the joy of the festival between siblings who live away from each other and only get to meet on the festival. This campaign was made in collaboration with KitKat and we cracked the idea of #throwbackthursday with Rakhi to create the campaign.
